response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer, but his profile does not match the core mandatory requirements of this role. His C++ experience is limited to a roughly six-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 plus a university thesis project, far short of the required 5–10 years of hands-on Windows C++ development. He has no discernible fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience (RIDE Capital was a German fintech for investment structuring, not capital markets systems), and no evidence of SQL Server or Oracle depth. His strengths lie in TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and web/full-stack work, which are largely irrelevant here.
strengths: Long, diverse engineering career with strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing)
Proven low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby)
Solid CI/CD, DevOps, and scripting skills matching the optional requirements
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ experience, and over a decade ago
No fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure
No demonstrated SQL Server/Oracle or Windows-platform development depth

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering fundamentals and performance work
